title: Build a community blog with sign-in and post submissions
summary: A poster says Codex built his AI news blog in about 30 minutes, with Google sign-in, reader submissions and an editor review step, hosted on Netlify.
agent_role: Codex wrote the site and made changes as the author kept asking; the author chose the idea and published it on Netlify.
outcome: Author reports a live site in about 30 minutes.
what_they_did: The poster started with an idea for an AI news blog and kept asking Codex for changes. The result has Google sign-in and a form for others to submit drafts. Submissions are reviewed before they go public. He hosted it on Netlify.
how_it_went: He says it took about 30 minutes and the site is live. At the time it listed four drafts and no published posts.
prompt: Build me a simple blog called [blog name] about [topic]. Include a homepage listing posts with search by topic, a sign-in with Google, and a form where signed-in visitors can submit a draft. Submissions must stay hidden until I approve them in an admin view. Show me the plan and the files first, then help me publish it on [hosting service]. Ask before creating any accounts or deploying.

curation.rationale: A genuine but common build: a live blog with sign-in and reviewed submissions made through conversation with Codex, with a live link as evidence but few build details.
